ANNOUNCEMENT 
 
Divi’s Labs to release unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026         
(Q1 FY27) on August 01, 2026 
 
Schedule of earnings conference call: August 01, 2026, at 14:00 hrs (IST) 
 
Post release of unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, the Management 
of the Company will host an earnings conference call on August 01, 2026, at 14:00 hrs (IST) 
to discuss the Company’s financial performance. A transcript of the conference call will be 
available at the Company’s website: www.divislabs.com. 
 
Earnings Conference call Dial-in Information:  
 
Option 1: Express Join with DiamondPass™ 
 
Pre-register and join without waiting for the operator: Click on the link for DiamondPass 
Registration. 
https://services.choruscall.in/DiamondPassRegistration/register?confirmationNumber=5267888&linkSecurityString=2cef0b9d90 
 
Option 2: Join through below Dial-In Numbers 
 
Universal Dial-In: 
+91 22 6280 1526 
+91 22 7115 8341 
 
To participate in the audio call, please dial the numbers provided above about five minutes 
ahead of the scheduled start time. The operator will provide instructions on asking questions 
before the call.
